data.name: Nav_Home
data.comment: Sidebar entry for the start page. Short: it has to fit the sidebar.

data.name: Nav_Songs
data.comment: Sidebar entry and heading of the page that lists every song (track) in the user's music library.

data.name: Nav_Albums
data.comment: Sidebar entry for the page that will list albums. Shown greyed out for now.

data.name: Nav_Artists
data.comment: Sidebar entry for the page that will list artists (singers, bands, musicians). Shown greyed out for now.

data.name: Nav_Playlists
data.comment: Sidebar entry for the page that will list the user's own playlists. Shown greyed out for now.

data.name: Nav_Studio
data.comment: Sidebar entry for the editor where music metadata (credits, covers, custom fields) is created. "Studio" means a creative workspace; a feature name, so a commonly used loanword is fine.

data.name: Nav_Settings
data.comment: Sidebar entry, title of the settings page and accessible name of the sidebar button.

data.name: Nav_SectionLibrary
data.comment: Small heading above the library entries in the sidebar.

data.name: Nav_SectionCreate
data.comment: Small heading above the Studio entry in the sidebar.

data.name: Nav_NotAvailable
data.comment: Tooltip of a sidebar entry whose page does not exist yet.

data.name: Window_Minimize
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the title bar button that minimizes the window to the taskbar.

data.name: Window_Maximize
data.comment: Accessible name (read by screen readers) of the title bar button that makes the window fill the screen. Not shown as text.

data.name: Window_Restore
data.comment: Accessible name of the same button while the window is maximized: it returns the window to its previous size. Not shown as text.

data.name: Window_Close
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the title bar button that closes the window.

data.name: Player_Shuffle
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that plays the queue in random order (verb or noun, as is usual on music players).

data.name: Player_Previous
data.comment: Tooltip of the button that goes to the previous song, and an item of the tray icon menu.

data.name: Player_Next
data.comment: Tooltip of the button that goes to the next song, and an item of the tray icon menu.

data.name: Player_Play
data.comment: Verb. Tray icon menu item that starts playback (shown while the music is paused), item of the song context menu, and accessible name of the play button on a song's cover.

data.name: Player_Pause
data.comment: Tray icon menu item that pauses playback. Verb. Shown while the music is playing.

data.name: Player_PlayPause
data.comment: Accessible name (read by screen readers) of the one round button that switches between playing and pausing. Not shown as text.

data.name: Player_Repeat
data.comment: Accessible name of the repeat button. Its tooltip shows one of the three "Repeat: ..." texts below.

data.name: Player_RepeatOff
data.comment: Tooltip of the repeat button when nothing repeats: the queue stops after the last song.

data.name: Player_RepeatAll
data.comment: Tooltip of the repeat button when the whole queue starts over after the last song.

data.name: Player_RepeatOne
data.comment: Tooltip of the repeat button when the current song plays again and again.

data.name: Player_Lyrics
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that opens the panel with the words of the song (song lyrics, not poetry). Also the heading of that panel.

data.name: Player_Queue
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that opens the list of songs that will play next (the play queue). Also the heading of that list.

data.name: Player_Mute
data.comment: Accessible name of the speaker icon button that switches the sound off and on. Not shown as text.

data.name: Player_Volume
data.comment: Accessible name of the volume slider (loudness). Not shown as text.

data.name: Tray_Open
data.comment: Tray icon menu item that shows the main window again. "Shirabe" is the app's name: do not translate it.

data.name: Tray_Quit
data.comment: Tray icon menu item that closes the app completely (closing the window only hides it to the tray).

data.name: Shortcuts_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. Keyboard shortcuts.

data.name: Shortcuts_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "Shortcuts" in the list of settings pages. "Keys" means keyboard keys.

data.name: Shortcuts_FixedKeys
data.value: Wähle ein Tastenkürzel aus, um es zu ändern. Esc schließt den Songtext- oder Warteschlangenbereich. Die Medientasten deiner Tastatur funktionieren, solange das Shirabe-Fenster aktiv ist.
data.comment: Explanation at the top of the keyboard shortcuts settings page. "Esc" is the Escape key. "Media keys" are the play/pause, next and previous keys some keyboards have.

data.name: Shortcuts_SeekBack
data.comment: Name of a keyboard shortcut: moves the playing song 5 seconds back.

data.name: Shortcuts_SeekForward
data.comment: Name of a keyboard shortcut: moves the playing song 5 seconds ahead.

data.name: Shortcuts_VolumeUp
data.comment: Name of a keyboard shortcut: makes the sound louder.

data.name: Shortcuts_VolumeDown
data.comment: Name of a keyboard shortcut: makes the sound quieter.

data.name: Shortcuts_PressKey
data.comment: Text on a button while the app waits for the user to press the new keyboard shortcut. Short.

data.name: Shortcuts_NotSet
data.comment: Text on a button of an action that has no keyboard shortcut. Short.

data.name: Shortcuts_CaptureHelp
data.value: Esc bricht ab. Die Rücktaste entfernt das Tastenkürzel.
data.comment: Help shown while the app waits for a new keyboard shortcut. "Esc" and "Backspace" are key names.

data.name: Shortcuts_Taken
data.value: Diese Taste ist bereits mit „{0}“ belegt. Drücke eine andere Taste oder Esc zum Abbrechen.
data.comment: Shown when the pressed keyboard shortcut belongs to another action. {0} is the name of that action.

data.name: Shortcuts_ResetAll
data.comment: Button that brings every keyboard shortcut back to the one the app came with.

data.name: Audio_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages.

data.name: Audio_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "Audio" in the list of settings pages. Lists what is on the page.

data.name: Audio_SectionOutput
data.comment: Small heading above the settings about where the sound goes. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Audio_Device
data.comment: Name of the setting where the user picks speakers or headphones. Also the accessible name of the drop-down list.

data.name: Audio_DeviceDescription
data.value: Die Lautsprecher oder Kopfhörer, über die Shirabe Musik abspielt.
data.comment: Explanation under "Output device". "Shirabe" is the app's name: do not translate it.

data.name: Audio_SystemDefault
data.comment: First entry of the output device list: whatever the operating system is set to use.

data.name: Audio_DeviceMissing
data.value: Das gewählte Gerät ist nicht verfügbar. Die Wiedergabe erfolgt über das Standardgerät des Systems.
data.comment: Warning under the output device list, e.g. when headphones are unplugged.

data.name: Audio_NowOutput
data.comment: Title of a line that shows the output device in use, its sample rate and channels.

data.name: Audio_NowSource
data.comment: Title of a line that shows technical facts about the loaded audio file: format, sample rate, channels, bit rate.

data.name: Audio_Unknown
data.comment: Shown when the app cannot tell which output device is in use.

data.name: Audio_KHz
data.comment: A sample rate. {0} is a number such as 44.1.

data.name: Audio_Channels
data.comment: Number of audio channels (2 is stereo). {0} is a number. Shown in the middle of a line of technical facts.

data.name: Audio_BitDepth
data.comment: Audio bit depth. {0} is a number such as 16 or 24.

data.name: Audio_Bitrate
data.comment: Audio bit rate in kilobits per second. {0} is a number.

data.name: Audio_SectionPlayback
data.comment: Small heading above the settings about speed, pitch and reverb. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Audio_Speed
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the speed button in the player bar and of its slider, and the title of the menu it opens.

data.name: Audio_SpeedControl
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Audio_SpeedControlDescription
data.value: Zeigt einen Geschwindigkeitsregler in der Wiedergabeleiste an, um Musik langsamer oder schneller abzuspielen. Aus: Songs werden in normaler Geschwindigkeit abgespielt.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Playback speed control" switch. "Off" means the switch is turned off.

data.name: Audio_Slowed
data.comment: Button in the speed menu that plays songs slower (0.8x). Very short: three buttons share one narrow row.

data.name: Audio_Normal
data.comment: Button in the speed menu for normal speed (1x). Very short: three buttons share one narrow row.

data.name: Audio_SpedUp
data.comment: Button in the speed menu that plays songs faster (1.25x). Very short: three buttons share one narrow row.

data.name: Audio_MoreSettings
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the gear button in the speed menu; it opens the settings page about audio.

data.name: Audio_KeepPitch
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch, in the settings and in the narrow speed menu. Also its accessible name. Short.

data.name: Audio_KeepPitchDescription
data.value: Ändert die Geschwindigkeit, ohne die Tonhöhe zu verändern. Aus: Schnellere Wiedergabe klingt höher, langsamere tiefer.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Keep pitch" switch. "Off" means the switch is turned off.

data.name: Audio_Reverb
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch, in the settings and in the narrow speed menu. Also its accessible name. The echo of a room. Short.

data.name: Audio_ReverbDescription
data.value: Fügt der Wiedergabe einen Raumhall hinzu.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Reverb" switch.

data.name: Audio_NeedsEffects
data.value: Für die Tonhöhenkorrektur, den Hall und den Equalizer wird die Bibliothek BASS_FX benötigt, die nicht geladen werden konnte.
data.comment: Warning above settings that are greyed out. "BASS_FX" is the name of a library: do not translate it.

data.name: Audio_SectionEqualizer
data.comment: Small heading above the equalizer settings. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Audio_Equalizer
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Audio_EqualizerDescription
data.value: Hebt oder senkt einzelne Frequenzbereiche an. Bei einer Anhebung wird der Gesamtpegel entsprechend abgesenkt, um Verzerrungen zu vermeiden.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Equalizer" switch.

data.name: Audio_EqualizerReset
data.comment: Button that puts every equalizer slider back to zero.

data.name: Audio_Hz
data.comment: A sound frequency, the name of an equalizer slider. {0} is a number.

data.name: Audio_Decibels
data.comment: The value of an equalizer slider in decibels. {0} is a signed number such as +3.

data.name: Audio_SectionVolume
data.comment: Small heading above the volume settings. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Audio_Normalize
data.comment: Name of a drop-down list that makes songs play at a similar loudness. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Audio_NormalizeDescription
data.value: Gleicht die Lautstärke von Songs anhand der ReplayGain-Tags in deinen Dateien an. Dateien ohne diese Tags werden unverändert abgespielt.
data.comment: Explanation under "Volume normalization". "ReplayGain" is the name of a standard: do not translate it.

data.name: Audio_NormalizeOff
data.comment: Entry of the "Volume normalization" list: no normalization.

data.name: Audio_NormalizeTrack
data.comment: Entry of the "Volume normalization" list: every song is evened out on its own.

data.name: Audio_NormalizeAlbum
data.comment: Entry of the "Volume normalization" list: albums are evened out as a whole, songs keep their differences within one.

data.name: Audio_Curve
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Audio_CurveDescription
data.value: Ermöglicht eine feinere Regelung bei niedriger Lautstärke. Bei aktivierter Option ist die Wiedergabe bei gleicher Reglerposition leiser.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Exponential volume curve" switch.

data.name: Audio_ScrollStep
data.comment: Name of a drop-down list: how much the volume changes per notch of the mouse wheel. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Audio_ScrollStepDescription
data.value: Legt fest, um wie viel sich die Lautstärke pro Mausradrastung ändert.
data.comment: Explanation under "Volume scroll step". The wheel is used over the volume slider.

data.name: General_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. Holds the everyday options.

data.name: General_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "General" in the list of settings pages. Lists what is on the page.

data.name: General_SectionStartup
data.comment: Small heading above the settings about what happens when the app starts. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: General_Resume
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name.

data.name: General_ResumeDescription
data.value: Stellt beim Start von Shirabe den letzten Song (pausiert an der letzten Position), die Lautstärke, die Zufallswiedergabe und den Wiederholungsmodus wieder her. Aus: Diese Einstellungen werden nicht wiederhergestellt.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Resume last session" switch. "Off" means the switch is turned off.

data.name: General_SectionWindow
data.comment: Small heading above the settings about the app's window. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: General_KeepInTray
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name. "Tray" is the system tray (notification area) with the app's small icon.

data.name: General_KeepInTrayDescription
data.value: Beim Schließen wird das Fenster ausgeblendet und die Musik läuft weiter. Über das Symbol im Infobereich lässt sich das Fenster wieder öffnen. Aus: Beim Schließen des Fensters wird Shirabe beendet. Deaktiviere diese Option auf Desktop-Umgebungen ohne Infobereich.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Keep running in the tray" switch. "Off" means the switch is turned off. "Tray" is the system tray (notification area).

data.name: General_SectionLanguage
data.comment: Small heading above the language setting. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: General_Language
data.comment: Name of the setting where the user picks the app's language. Also the accessible name of the drop-down list.

data.name: General_LanguageDescription
data.value: Die Sprache der App. Noch nicht übersetzte Inhalte bleiben auf Englisch.
data.comment: Explanation under the language drop-down. "Parts" means screens and texts that still have no translation.

data.name: General_MachineTranslated
data.comment: Note under the language drop-down, shown when the language on screen was translated by a computer and may contain mistakes.

data.name: General_HelpTranslate
data.comment: Name of a row with a button that opens the project's translation page. Also the accessible name of that button.

data.name: General_HelpTranslateDescription
data.value: Übersetzungen auf Crowdin ergänzen oder korrigieren.
data.comment: Hint under "Help translate". "Crowdin" is a product name.

data.name: Language_System
data.comment: First entry of the language drop-down: use the language of the operating system.

data.name: Appearance_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. Holds the look of the app: colours and animations.

data.name: Appearance_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "Appearance" in the list of settings pages. The source uses British spelling.

data.name: Appearance_SectionTheme
data.comment: Small heading above the theme setting. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Appearance_Theme
data.comment: Name of the setting where the user picks a theme: a named colour scheme such as "Dark". Also the accessible name of the drop-down list.

data.name: Appearance_ThemeDescription
data.comment: Explanation under the theme drop-down.

data.name: Appearance_CustomThemesHint
data.value: Eigene Designs hinzufügen: Lege eine .json-Datei mit „name“ und beliebigen dieser Farben im Format #RRGGBB (accent, background, sidebar, surface, surfaceHover, divider, textPrimary, textSecondary, track) in folgendem Ordner ab: {0}. Starte die App anschließend neu. Nicht angegebene Farben werden aus dem dunklen Design übernommen.
data.comment: {0} is a folder path, or the text of Appearance_ThemesFolder. Keep the colour names (accent, background...) and "name" as they are: they are keys in the file.

data.name: Appearance_ThemesFolder
data.comment: Inserted as {0} into Appearance_CustomThemesHint when the folder path is not known. It must read naturally right after "in" in that sentence.

data.name: Theme_NeedsName
data.comment: Problem listed under the theme setting for a theme file without a name. It follows the file name and a colon, e.g. "mytheme.json: needs a "name"". Keep "name" as it is: it is a key in the file.

data.name: Theme_BadColour
data.comment: Problem listed under the theme setting. {0} is a key of the theme file (accent, background...): do not translate it. "#RRGGBB" is the colour format: keep it.

data.name: Theme_NameTaken
data.comment: Problem listed under the theme setting. It follows the file name and a colon. {0} is the theme's name.

data.name: Appearance_SectionAccent
data.comment: Small heading above the accent colour setting (the highlight colour of buttons and sliders). Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Appearance_Follow
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. "Cover" is the album artwork of the song that is playing. Also the accessible name.

data.name: Appearance_FollowDescription
data.value: Passt die Akzentfarbe an das Cover des aktuell abgespielten Songs an. Aus: Die Akzentfarbe des Designs bleibt erhalten.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Follow the cover" switch. "Off" means the switch is turned off.

data.name: Appearance_SectionMotion
data.comment: Small heading above the animation setting. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Appearance_ReduceMotion
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch that turns animations off (an accessibility option, like the one in the operating system). Also its accessible name.

data.name: Appearance_ReduceMotionDescription
data.comment: Explanation under the "Reduce motion" switch.

data.name: Lyrics_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. "Lyrics" means the words of a song.

data.name: Lyrics_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "Lyrics" in the list of settings pages. Lists what is on the page.

data.name: Lyrics_SectionText
data.comment: Small heading above the settings about how the lyrics text looks. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Lyrics_TextSize
data.comment: Name of the setting (a slider) for how large the lyrics are.

data.name: Lyrics_TextSizeDescription
data.value: Legt die Schriftgröße im Songtextbereich fest.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Text size" setting.

data.name: Lyrics_TextSizeName
data.comment: Accessible name of the slider.

data.name: Lyrics_TextSizeValue
data.comment: Value shown next to the text size slider. {0} is a whole number; "pt" is the abbreviation of typographic points.

data.name: Lyrics_SectionShown
data.comment: Small heading above the switches that choose which parts of the lyrics are displayed. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Lyrics_BackgroundVocals
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Background vocals are the secondary voices of a song (backing vocals, echoes, ad-libs). Also its accessible name.

data.name: Lyrics_BackgroundVocalsDescription
data.value: Zeigt die Hintergrundstimmen an, die in manchen Songtexten in Klammern stehen.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Background vocals" switch. Such parts appear in brackets in the lyrics text.

data.name: Lyrics_BreakMarkers
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. The markers are three dots shown in the lyrics while the song has no singing. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Lyrics_BreakMarkersDescription
data.value: Zeigt drei Punkte an, die sich während einer Instrumentalpassage nach und nach füllen.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Break markers" switch. An instrumental break is a part of the song without singing.

data.name: Lyrics_SectionTiming
data.comment: Small heading above the setting that fine-tunes when lyrics light up. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Lyrics_Delay
data.comment: Name of the setting (a slider) that shifts the moment a lyric line is highlighted, in milliseconds. "Highlight" means the line being sung is made bright.

data.name: Lyrics_DelayDescription
data.value: Erhöhe den Wert, wenn die Hervorhebung der Musik voraus ist, und verringere ihn, wenn sie hinterherhinkt. Der Ton erreicht die Lautsprecher etwas später als von der Wiedergabeposition angezeigt.
data.comment: Explanation under the "Highlight delay" slider. "Raise" and "lower" refer to moving the slider.

data.name: Lyrics_DelayName
data.comment: Accessible name of the slider.

data.name: Lyrics_NoDelay
data.comment: Value shown next to the highlight delay slider when it is at zero, instead of "0 ms".

data.name: Lyrics_DelayValue
data.comment: {0} is a number with a sign, such as +120 or -50. "ms" is the abbreviation of milliseconds.

data.name: Connections_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. Holds the options that talk to outside services.

data.name: Connections_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "Connections" in the list of settings pages. "Discord" and "Last.fm" are product names: do not translate them.

data.name: Connections_SectionDiscord
data.comment: Small heading above the Discord settings. "Discord" is a product name: do not translate it.

data.name: Connections_Presence
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch that shows the current song on the user's Discord profile.

data.name: Connections_PresenceDescription
data.value: Zeigt den aktuell abgespielten Song als „Hört“ auf deinem Discord-Profil an. Discord muss dafür laufen.
data.comment: Explanation under the switch. "Listening to" is the label Discord itself shows on the card; use Discord's wording in your language if you know it.

data.name: Connections_PresenceName
data.comment: Accessible name of the switch.

data.name: Connections_CoverLookup
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. A cover is the album artwork.

data.name: Connections_CoverLookupDescription
data.value: Sendet den Künstler- und Albumnamen an Apples iTunes Search, um ein Cover für die Discord-Anzeige zu finden. Keine weiteren Daten verlassen deinen Computer.
data.comment: Privacy explanation under the switch: keep the meaning exact. "iTunes Search" is Apple's service name: do not translate it.

data.name: Connections_CoverLookupName
data.comment: Accessible name of the switch.

data.name: Connections_SectionArtwork
data.comment: Small heading above the setting about downloading cover images. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Connections_DownloadArtwork
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. "Linked" means a song's metadata contains a web link to its cover image. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Connections_DownloadArtworkDescription
data.value: Wenn die Metadaten eines Songs auf ein Cover verweisen, wird dieses bei der Anzeige des Songs heruntergeladen und auf diesem Computer gespeichert. Die Website, von der das Cover stammt, kann deine IP-Adresse und die Tatsache sehen, dass du diesen Song abgespielt hast.
data.comment: Privacy explanation under the switch: keep the meaning exact. "Your address" means the user's internet (IP) address.

data.name: LastFm_Section
data.comment: Small heading above the Last.fm settings. "Last.fm" is a product name: do not translate it.

data.name: LastFm_Account
data.comment: Name of the settings row about the user's Last.fm account.

data.name: LastFm_SignedOut
data.value: Melde dich auf der Website von Last.fm an. Shirabe erhält zu keinem Zeitpunkt dein Passwort.
data.comment: Under "Account" when the user is not signed in. "Last.fm" and "Shirabe" are product names.

data.name: LastFm_Waiting
data.value: Erlaube den Zugriff im Browser und kehre anschließend hierher zurück.
data.comment: Under "Account" while the app waits for the user to approve it on the website that was just opened.

data.name: LastFm_SignedInAs
data.comment: Under "Account". {0} is the user's Last.fm user name: keep it as it is.

data.name: LastFm_Unavailable
data.value: Diese Version von Shirabe wurde ohne Last.fm-API-Schlüssel erstellt.
data.comment: Under "Account" in a copy of the app that cannot use Last.fm. An API key is a code that identifies an app to a web service; a build is one compiled copy of the app.

data.name: LastFm_Connect
data.comment: Button: starts signing in to Last.fm. Short.

data.name: LastFm_Cancel
data.comment: Button: stops waiting for the sign-in. Short.

data.name: LastFm_Disconnect
data.comment: Button: signs out of Last.fm in this app. Short.

data.name: LastFm_ViewProfile
data.comment: Button: opens the user's page on the Last.fm website. Short.

data.name: LastFm_Scrobble
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch, also its accessible name. To "scrobble" is Last.fm's word for adding a played song to the user's listening history; use Last.fm's wording in your language if you know it.

data.name: LastFm_ScrobbleDescription
data.value: Sendet bei bestehender Verbindung Künstler, Titel, Album, Dauer und Startzeit der abgespielten Songs an Last.fm.
data.comment: Privacy explanation under the switch: keep the meaning exact. "Last.fm" is a product name.

data.name: LastFm_NoStorage
data.value: Shirabe kann auf diesem Computer keinen sicheren Speicher nutzen. Daher musst du dich bei jedem Start erneut bei Last.fm anmelden.
data.comment: Warning. "Secure storage" is the system's protected place for passwords and keys (Windows Credential Manager, a Linux keyring).

data.name: LastFm_NotAllowed
data.value: Der Zugriff wurde nicht rechtzeitig erlaubt. Versuche es erneut.
data.comment: Error after the user did not approve the app on the Last.fm website within a few minutes.

data.name: LastFm_Unreachable
data.value: Last.fm konnte nicht erreicht werden. Überprüfe deine Verbindung und versuche es erneut.
data.comment: Error after a failed sign-in: no internet connection, or the website does not answer.

data.name: LastFm_Failed
data.comment: Error. {0} is the reason given by Last.fm, in English.

data.name: LastFm_NotRemoved
data.value: Die gespeicherten Anmeldedaten konnten nicht entfernt werden. Die Anmeldung könnte daher nach einem Neustart wiederhergestellt werden. Du kannst Shirabe den Zugriff in den Last.fm-Einstellungen unter „Anwendungen“ entziehen.
data.comment: Error after signing out. "Applications" is the name of a page in the settings of the Last.fm website; to revoke access means to take the permission away.

data.name: LastFm_Credit
data.comment: Credit that Last.fm asks for. "AudioScrobbler" is a product name: do not translate it.

data.name: LastFm_CreditDescription
data.value: Die Kontofunktionen werden von Last.fm bereitgestellt.
data.comment: Under the credit "Powered by AudioScrobbler". "Last.fm" is a product name.

data.name: LastFm_Open
data.comment: Button: opens the Last.fm website. "Last.fm" is a product name.

data.name: Scrobbler_Title
data.comment: Heading of a small message in the title bar. A scrobbler is the part of an app that adds played songs to the user's Last.fm listening history; use Last.fm's wording in your language if you know it.

data.name: Scrobbler_Done
data.comment: Message after a song was added to the Last.fm history. {0} is the song title, {1} the artist: keep both. It is cut off when long.

data.name: Scrobbler_Ignored
data.comment: Message when Last.fm received a song but did not add it to the history. {0} is the song title, {1} the artist.

data.name: Scrobbler_Failed
data.comment: Message when a song could not be sent to Last.fm. {0} is the song title, {1} the artist.

data.name: About_Title
data.comment: Name of a settings page, in the list of pages. It shows the app's version, license and credits.

data.name: About_Description
data.comment: One short line under the page name "About" in the list of settings pages.

data.name: About_SectionApp
data.comment: Small heading above the version and links. "Shirabe" is the product name: do not translate it. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: About_Tagline
data.value: Musik verdient mehr als nur eine Play-Taste.
data.comment: The project's motto, shown at the top of the About page. Translate the idea, not word for word. "Play button" is the button that starts a song.

data.name: About_Version
data.comment: Name of the row that shows the app's version number, for example 0.1.0.

data.name: About_VersionDescription
data.value: Gib diese bei einer Problemmeldung an.
data.comment: Short hint under "Version".

data.name: About_Commit
data.comment: Name of the row that shows the short code (a git commit hash such as ce863a5e7) identifying the exact source code this build was made from.

data.name: About_CommitDescription
data.value: Der genaue Quellcode, aus dem dieser Build erstellt wurde.
data.comment: Short hint under "Build".

data.name: About_License
data.comment: Name of the row that tells under which license the app is released.

data.name: About_LicenseDescription
data.value: Shirabe ist kostenlos und quelloffen und steht unter der Apache License 2.0.
data.comment: Hint under "License". "Apache License 2.0" is the official license name: do not translate it.

data.name: About_Source
data.comment: Name of a row with a button that opens the project's page on GitHub.

data.name: About_SourceDescription
data.value: Shirabe wird öffentlich auf GitHub entwickelt.
data.comment: Hint under "Source code". "GitHub" is a product name.

data.name: About_ReportProblem
data.comment: Name of a row with a button that opens the project's issue tracker on GitHub.

data.name: About_ReportProblemDescription
data.value: Einen Fehler gefunden oder eine Idee? Erstelle ein Issue auf GitHub.
data.comment: Hint under "Report a problem". An "issue" is a report on GitHub's issue tracker.

data.name: About_Open
data.comment: Button that opens a web page in the browser. Short: it sits at the right end of a row.

data.name: About_SectionCredits
data.comment: Small heading above the list of people. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: About_Author
data.comment: Role of the person named in the row's description. The name itself is not translated.

data.name: About_SectionAudio
data.comment: Small heading above the notice about the audio library used to play music. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: About_AudioNotice
data.value: Die Audiowiedergabe verwendet BASS, Copyright © 1999-2026 Un4seen Developments Ltd. BASS ist proprietäre Software. Sie fällt nicht unter die Lizenz von Shirabe und wird gemäß den Bedingungen von Un4seen für die kostenlose, nicht kommerzielle Nutzung verwendet.
data.comment: Legal notice: keep the meaning exact. "BASS" and "Un4seen Developments Ltd." are names: do not translate them. "Proprietary" means not open source.

data.name: About_AudioWebsite
data.comment: Name of a row with a button that opens the BASS audio library's website. "BASS" is a product name.

data.name: About_AudioWebsiteDescription
data.comment: Hint under "BASS website": the company that makes BASS. A company name: do not translate it.

data.name: About_SectionThirdParty
data.comment: Small heading above the list of open-source libraries and resources the app is built with. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: About_ThirdPartyIntro
data.value: Shirabe verwendet diese Open-Source-Komponenten. Jede wird unter ihrer eigenen Lizenz genutzt.
data.comment: Sentence above the list of components. "Open-source" means the source code is public and free to use.

data.name: About_CopyHint
data.comment: Tooltip of the version and build buttons: clicking one copies its text to the clipboard.

data.name: About_Copied
data.comment: Shown for a moment on the version or build button after its text was copied to the clipboard. Short: it replaces the button's text.

data.name: Common_UnknownArtist
data.comment: Shown in place of the artist's name when a song has none (song list, queue, player bar).

data.name: Songs_Cancel
data.comment: Button that stops the scan of a music folder that is in progress.

data.name: Songs_AddFolder
data.comment: Button that opens a dialog to choose a folder with music; the app then scans it and adds the songs to the library.

data.name: Songs_Summary
data.comment: Line under the page heading "Songs". {0:N0} is the number of songs, formatted with thousands separators: keep {0:N0} as it is. Worded without a counted noun on purpose, so it needs no plural forms.

data.name: Songs_ColTitle
data.comment: Column heading of the song list: the song's title. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case. Short.

data.name: Songs_ColArtist
data.comment: Column heading of the song list: the performer. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case. Short.

data.name: Songs_ColAlbum
data.comment: Column heading of the song list: the album the song is on. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case. Short.

data.name: Songs_ColTime
data.comment: Column heading of the song list: the song's length (duration). Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case. Short.

data.name: Songs_PlayNext
data.comment: Item of the song context menu: puts the song right after the one that is playing.

data.name: Songs_AddToQueue
data.comment: Item of the song context menu: puts the song at the end of the play queue.

data.name: Songs_Properties
data.comment: Item of the song context menu: opens a dialog with the song's details, tags and custom fields.

data.name: Songs_EmptyTitle
data.comment: Heading shown on the Songs page while the library is empty.

data.name: Songs_EmptyHint
data.value: Füge einen Ordner hinzu und Shirabe findet die darin enthaltene Musik.
data.comment: Hint under "No songs yet". "Shirabe" is the app's name: do not translate it.

data.name: Songs_ChooseFolder
data.comment: Title of the operating system's folder dialog opened by "Add folder".

data.name: Songs_LoadFailed
data.value: Die Mediathek konnte nicht geladen werden: {0}
data.comment: Error line on the Songs page. {0} is the technical reason, often in English.

data.name: Songs_ScanLooking
data.comment: Status while a folder scan starts, before the number of files is known.

data.name: Songs_ScanProgress
data.comment: Status during a folder scan: {0} files done, {1} files in total. Keep {0:N0} and {1:N0} as they are.

data.name: Songs_ScanCancelled
data.comment: Status after the user stopped a folder scan.

data.name: Songs_ScanFailed
data.comment: Error line on the Songs page. {0} is a folder path, {1} the technical reason, often in English.

data.name: Songs_ScanFinished
data.comment: Summary after a folder scan. {0} is a list of results separated by commas, made from the "Songs_Scan..." texts, e.g. "3 added, 1 updated, 10 unchanged".

data.name: Songs_ScanAdded
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many new songs were found. Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Songs_ScanUpdated
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many songs were already known but changed (for example retagged). Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Songs_ScanUnchanged
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many songs were already known and had not changed. Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Songs_ScanMissing
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many known songs have disappeared from the folder. Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Songs_ScanFailedFiles
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many files were skipped because they are damaged or not audio. Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Songs_ScanDocumentProblems
data.comment: Part of the scan summary: how many metadata documents (small .shirabe.json files or tags that describe a song) were damaged or broke the format's rules. Keep {0:N0} as it is.

data.name: Queue_Clear
data.comment: Small button in the queue panel that empties the queue.

data.name: Queue_ClearTip
data.value: Alles außer dem aktuell abgespielten Song entfernen
data.comment: Tooltip of the "Clear" button of the queue panel.

data.name: Queue_Remove
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the small X button on a queue row.

data.name: Queue_EmptyTitle
data.comment: Heading shown in the queue panel when no songs are queued.

data.name: Queue_EmptyHint
data.value: Spiele einen Song aus der Liste ab, um eine Warteschlange zu starten.
data.comment: Hint under "The queue is empty". "One" means a queue.

data.name: LyricsPanel_NothingPlaying
data.comment: Heading shown in the lyrics panel while no song is loaded.

data.name: LyricsPanel_NoLyrics
data.comment: Heading shown in the lyrics panel when the loaded song has no lyrics.

data.name: LyricsPanel_PlayHint
data.value: Spiele einen Song ab, um hier den Songtext zu sehen.
data.comment: Hint under "Nothing is playing".

data.name: LyricsPanel_AddHint
data.value: Lege eine gleichnamige .lrc- oder .ttml-Datei neben der Audiodatei ab oder füge den Songtext zu den Tags der Datei hinzu.
data.comment: Hint under "No lyrics for this song". ".lrc" and ".ttml" are file extensions: keep them. "Tags" are the information stored inside the audio file (title, artist, lyrics...).

data.name: Home_DropTitle
data.comment: Large text on the start page's drop area. Read together with Home_DropHint: "Drop an audio file here" + "to start listening".

data.name: Home_DropHint
data.comment: Second line under Home_DropTitle. It continues the sentence of the line above it.

data.name: Player_NothingPlaying
data.comment: Title in the player bar while no song is loaded.

data.name: Player_CannotPlay
data.comment: Error in the player bar. {0} is a song title, {1} the technical reason, often in English.

data.name: Player_CannotPlayAgain
data.comment: Error in the player bar when a song could not be loaded again after the app released its file for a moment. {0} is a song title, {1} the technical reason, often in English.

data.name: Player_FileGone
data.value: {0} kann nicht abgespielt werden: Die Datei wurde verschoben oder gelöscht. Füge den Ordner erneut hinzu, um die Mediathek zu aktualisieren.
data.comment: Error in the player bar. {0} is a song title.

data.name: Startup_AudioEngine
data.value:
Die Audio-Engine konnte nicht gestartet werden: {0}
Siehe native/README.md.
data.comment: Error shown on the start page when the sound library (BASS) is missing. {0} is the technical reason, often in English. Keep the line breaks and "native/README.md" (a file name).

data.name: Startup_LibraryOpen
data.value: Die Mediathek konnte nicht geöffnet werden ({0}): {1}
data.comment: Error shown on the start page. {0} is the path of the library's database file, {1} the technical reason, often in English.

data.name: Connections_SectionUpdates
data.comment: Small heading above the setting about checking for new versions. Keep it uppercase if the language has letter case.

data.name: Connections_CheckForUpdates
data.comment: Name of an on/off switch. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Connections_CheckForUpdatesDescription
data.value: Fragt beim Start von Shirabe bei GitHub nach, ob eine neuere Version verfügbar ist, und benachrichtigt dich gegebenenfalls. GitHub kann deine IP-Adresse sehen; es werden keine weiteren Daten gesendet. Wird beim nächsten Start von Shirabe wirksam.
data.comment: Privacy explanation under the switch: keep the meaning exact. "GitHub" is a product name. "Your address" means the user's internet (IP) address.

data.name: Connections_UpdateChannel
data.comment: Name of a list choosing which kind of new versions are offered. Also its accessible name.

data.name: Connections_UpdateChannelDescription
data.value: Beta bietet auch frühe Testversionen an, die mehr Fehler enthalten können. Beim Wechsel zurück zu Stabil bleibt die installierte Version erhalten, bis eine neuere stabile Version erscheint. Wird beim nächsten Start von Shirabe wirksam.
data.comment: Explanation under the update channel list. "Beta" and "Stable" must match the names of the two choices.

data.name: Connections_UpdateChannelStable
data.comment: Update channel choice: only finished releases.

data.name: Connections_UpdateChannelBeta
data.comment: Update channel choice: test versions as well.

data.name: Update_Title
data.comment: Title of a notification. {0} is the new version number, for example 0.2.0: keep it as it is.

data.name: Update_Message
data.value: Lade die neue Version von GitHub herunter oder aktualisiere Shirabe über die Paketverwaltung, mit der du es installiert hast.
data.comment: Body of the notification about a new version. A package manager is a tool such as winget, Scoop, Homebrew or apt that installs and updates programs. "GitHub" is a product name.

data.name: Update_ViewRelease
data.comment: Button of the new-version notification: opens the page where the new version can be downloaded. Short.

data.name: Update_SelfMessage
data.value: Shirabe kann die neue Version für dich herunterladen und installieren.
data.comment: Body of the notification about a new version, shown when the app can update itself.

data.name: Update_Install
data.comment: Button of the new-version notification: downloads the new version. A verb. Short.

data.name: Update_Downloading
data.comment: Body of the update notification while the new version downloads. {0} is a number from 0 to 100: keep it as it is.

data.name: Update_Ready
data.value: Download abgeschlossen. Starte Shirabe neu, um das Update jetzt zu installieren. Andernfalls wird es beim nächsten Start installiert.
data.comment: Body of the update notification after the download has finished. "Shirabe" is the app's name.

data.name: Update_Restart
data.comment: Button of the update notification: closes the app, installs the new version and opens it again. Short.

data.name: Update_Failed
data.value: Das Update ist fehlgeschlagen. Versuche es erneut oder lade es von der Release-Seite herunter.
data.comment: Body of the update notification when downloading or installing the new version failed.

data.name: Update_TryAgain
data.comment: Button of the update notification after a failed download: starts the download again. Short.

data.name: Notification_Dismiss
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the close (X) button of a notification: it removes the notification.
